response.sql: WITH race_avg AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS p, AVG(wins) AS w FROM constructorStandings GROUP BY raceId), country_avg AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(ra.p) AS avg_points, AVG(ra.w) AS avg_wins FROM circuits c LEFT JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId LEFT JOIN race_avg ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_avg) AS avg_wins_minus_mean FROM country_avg

assumptions.assumption: Each race's figure is the plain average of its constructorStandings rows (every constructor listed for that race), and each country's figure is the plain average of its races' figures, so races without standings rows add nothing. Every country in circuits is returned. A country with no usable races gets NULL averages, and the simple mean of country averages skips those NULLs.
